description: How gowebserver is doing: requests by what answered them, where directory listings, the text viewer, uploads and proxied requests spend their time, and the process itself. Thumbnails have a dashboard of their own.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Servers Prometheus can scrape.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Versions running, from target_info.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status. Alert: GowebserverServerErrors above 5%.

panels.title: Time to first byte (p95)
panels.description: How long the slowest 5% of requests waited for their response to start, leaving out thumbnails, uploads and proxied requests. Alert: GowebserverSlowResponses above 1 s for a handler.

panels.title: Requests being served
panels.description: Requests in progress now, downloads included.

panels.title: Requests by handler
panels.description: What answered: file (a file's bytes), listing (the file browser's page), thumbnail, richview (the text viewer), upload, proxy, index (the list of served paths).

panels.title: Time to first byte by handler (p95)
panels.description: From a request arriving to the first byte of its response: the server's own work, without the time the client takes to download the body.

panels.title: Time to first byte by handler (median)
Request duration by handler (p95)
panels.description: The whole request, sending the body included: for files this is mostly how fast clients download.

panels.title: Requests being served
panels.description: By the handler a request was first routed to: everything under a served path counts as file here, whatever answers it.

panels.title: Listing stages (p95)
panels.description: open: opening the directory. read: reading its entries. stat: the size and time of each entry. sort. render: writing the page to the client.

panels.title: Where listing time goes
panels.description: Seconds spent in each stage per second.

panels.title: Entries per listing
panels.description: How many entries the listed directories hold. Every stage's time follows this.

panels.title: Text viewer requests by result
panels.description: highlighted, oversized (too large to show), binary (served as the file), directory (redirected), failed.

panels.title: Text viewer stages (p95)
panels.description: read: the file into memory. highlight: finding its language and coloring it. render: writing the page. Nothing is kept, so every view repeats all three.

panels.title: Follow streams by how they ended
panels.description: ended (the browser went away), gone (the log was deleted), limit (30 minutes of following), refused (not a log, not text, or all 32 streams were taken), failed. A refused stream is a 404/415/503, not a page.

panels.title: Logs being followed
panels.description: Streams open right now. Each server follows at most 32 logs at a time; the 33rd browser gets a 503 until one of these ends.

panels.title: Lines streamed while following
panels.description: Complete lines only: a line whose newline has not been written yet is held back, so this lags the file by a line at most.

panels.title: Uploads by result
panels.description: ok, rejected (another origin, or not a form), failed (the server could not store a file). Alert: GowebserverUploadFailures.

panels.title: Upload duration (p95)
panels.description: Receiving the files included, so mostly the client's connection.

panels.title: Requests passed on by status
panels.description: Requests to the servers gowebserver proxies to. Empty unless a served path is an http(s) URL.

panels.title: Upstream duration (p95)
panels.description: Alert: GowebserverSlowProxyUpstream above 5 s.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores in use.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Decoding a large photo takes a lot of memory, and one can be decoded per CPU at a time. Alert: GowebserverHighMemory.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Alert: GowebserverGoroutines above 10000.

panels.title: File descriptors
panels.description: Alert: GowebserverFileDescriptors above 80% of the limit.

title: gowebserver
